annotations.title: Prepare a VAT return to file in the browser

description: Derives the VAT return for the quarter ending on periodEnd from the session's loaded book, exactly as derive_vat_return does, and answers a link to the VAT form on the Submit site with the seven figures filled in (the form works out boxes 3 and 5 itself). This tool never files anything and reaches no outside service. The person opens the link, checks the figures on the page, ticks the declaration and files there; the figures filed are the figures the page shows.

periodEnd.description: The obligation's period end, YYYY-MM-DD; must be a month end the book's VAT interface carries

periodStart.description: The obligation's period start, YYYY-MM-DD; refused unless it opens the quarter ending periodEnd

name: prepare_vat_return
